product.title: 독특 수제간식 강아지 치킨(3P 총중량120g) 멍치킨, 1개

meme.title: 통닭 털어 놓고 친구를 고발함
meme.scene: first-person POV of an angry owner holding a smartphone; bright modern home kitchen, white cabinets, light wood floor, cool daylight from a window on the left; in the foreground a torn-apart greasy human roast chicken carcass scattered on the floor (glistening skin, shredded meat, bones, grease smears). Shiba A (left): red-orange coat, cream chest, adult, slightly bigger. Shiba B (right): cream-sesame coat, slightly smaller. No clothes, no collars, no people's faces, no text.
panels: 0s. Camera tilted down at the chicken mess on the floor, both dogs sitting just behind it, frozen and staring at the camera; the owner's hand points down at the mess from the top edge.

2s. Both dogs framed. Shiba A on the left has its right front paw stretched out sideways, the tip of the paw pointing precisely at Shiba B, mouth slightly open, eyebrows up, shameless accusing face. Shiba B on the right sits with front paws together, head lowered, ears flattened back, guilty eyes looking up.
4s. Shiba A thrusts its head toward the camera barking loudly, mouth wide open showing teeth and tongue, ears forward, defiant glare; Shiba B still head down, eyes rolled up toward Shiba A.

7.5s. Extreme close-up from the phone on Shiba A's raised right front paw: glossy chicken grease and a shred of roast chicken meat stuck in the fur, Shiba A's surprised wide eyes just visible above it.
9s. Shiba A has tucked its paw behind its body and looks away to the side with an awkward guilty face, cheeks puffed as if swallowing; Shiba B has lifted its head and stares flatly at Shiba A.

12s (ad shot, chicken mess cleaned away, warmer light). Shiba A sits front and center facing the camera with a smug confident face; in front of it a woven rattan basket full of the golden crumb-coated chicken-drumstick shaped dog treats exactly like the real product image; Shiba B sits behind on the right drooling at the basket.
meme.vo: 강아지가 먹는 치킨은 따로 있다. 구매는 프로필 링크에서.
meme.line_a: 사실 우리가 원한 건 뻑뻑한 통닭이 아니야!
